lines.en: : Hey! Wanna sing a duet with me? I was planning on doing Niki’s Christmas song, but we can do something else if you’re still all emotional about the amount of my dad’s jizz that she’s swallowed.
: Ha ha ha. True. Yet it is I, Maya, who is not currently estranged from him and has been chosen once more as the object of his affection. Get fucked.
: I’d love to, but I feel like I’d have to top wearing this outfit and I kind of just want to be tied up and edged for the next nine hours. When do you think he and Ayane will be back?

: I don’t know. But I’m going to go out on a limb here and submit a formal verbal request for you to stop being a domineering, manipulative bitch for one night so I can go to town on him without fear of you interfering once he is.
: Wow. You and Ayane are both super forward tonight. What brought this on?
: Love.
: What a boring answer. The lead-up made me feel like it would be a little more interesting than just that.
: I’m annoyed that there has to be a lead-up at all. But seeing as you’d probably just cock-block me again if I tried something without telling you, here I am.
: So please, Ami — fearful and all-powerful master of time — allow me to fuck your dad without worrying about you getting in the way. I am literally desperate.
: You don’t look desperate. Get on your knees and ask again.
: Fine. Oh, Ami — queen of the universe and champion of paternal cock-
: Okay, okay! Get up. I didn’t think you’d actually do it right in front of everyone.
: You really are desperate, aren’t you?
: I finally have a chance to make him mine again and I will stop at absolutely nothing to ensure that happens.
: He’ll never be yours, Maya. So don’t go getting your hopes up just because he told you he loves you or something. I’m guessing that’s what happened, right?
: Yes. And know that if you reverse time again to a point where that didn’t happen, I will find you and gut you.
: How many times do I have to tell you I can’t do that?
: Zero more if you give me permission to have passionate, violent, uninhibited sex with your father tonight.
: How about I just break out the magic wand again? That’s so much easier and less messy, don’t you think?
: Ami, that is not the same and you know it.
: It’s probably better if orgasm frequency is the metric we’re going by. How many did you have the last time I tied you up again? You really think my dad is going to beat that?
: You look angry. Why?
: What do you mean why?!
: It’s bad enough that my boyfriend...thing’s daughter has repeatedly raped me, but it’s even worse when she brags about it and holds it over my head like it’s something I want!
: Oh yeah. That does sound pretty bad, doesn’t it?
: It is bad!
: Hmm...then how come you liked it so much?
: How come you did?! You’re straight! At least I’m attracted to girls!
: Awww, you’re attracted to me? That’s so sweet. But I’m sorry, Maya — my heart belongs to someone else. And having sex with him will not make your feelings for me simply disappear.
: Whatever you want, name it. I’ll do it. Just put your psychopath shit on hold for one night. That is all I ask.
: You know, you should really think higher of yourself, Maya. Girls as cute as you shouldn’t be begging for anything.
: You should just take whatever it is you want. That’s what I do and it’s working pretty well for me.
: Yes. Well you don’t have to deal with the looming threat of being abused by an omniscient being!
: Ah, yes. Sounds horrible. Boo-hoo.
: Anything. Just name it. I’ll let you tie me up for an entire week if that’s what you want. Just leave us alone for one night.
: Just do it. You don’t need to ask me for permission. And I don’t need anything in return.
: ...What?
: I’m waiting for the catch.
: There is no catch. I kind of want to just hang out and enjoy Christmalloween tonight. If you want to fuck my dad, Maya — you go right ahead.
: Perhaps I did not make myself abundantly clear. I want to do that without you being involved in any capacity.
: Do not watch. Do not listen. And do not waltz into the room with a strap-on and join him in penetrating me, despite how insanely hot that sounds.
: Do not wait outside of the door and say some sketchy shit once we’re done. Do not talk to me about it once we’re done. Just let it happen and exist elsewhere. Do you understand?
: So, are we going to sing a duet or not? I don’t want to just stand here and hog the mic all night.
: Leave. Us. Alone.
: Again, I will. You’ve earned a night or two of uninhibited debauchery after all I’ve put you through. And in the spirit of Christmalloween, I will give that to you. No strings attached.
: There are always strings attached with you when I’m basically your fucking puppet now.
: And what a cute puppet you are.
: Just imagine I’m leaving you in the box tonight. And if someone comes along and borrows you for a little while, I’ll be none the wiser if they put you back like normal before I open it again.
: Perhaps I did not make myself abundantly clear — part two. If all goes according to plan, I will most definitely not be returned “like normal.”
: I will be broken and bruised and inflated by the semen of an adult man that I will allow to have complete and total control over my body. I will be used and abused and perhaps even killed.

: And this will be okay, for it is what I want. And when that happens and I am returned to your “box” like the cum-rag I intend to become tonight, I want you to close it, lock it, and hurl it off a bridge to never be seen again.
: You’re putting a lot of stake in the sexual capabilities of my father. I still think you’d be better off handing me the reins if that’s the outcome you desire, Maya.
: Do not interfere.
: Can you send me a picture at least? The thought of you in such a despicable state is kind of turning me on.
: Goodbye.
: Does this mean I have to sing alone?
: Things are still somewhat awkward between us now, aren’t they?
: I’m glad you said it. Which isn’t to say I wouldn’t be able to. It just shows that you’re becoming a little better at understanding human emotion.
: Perhaps that’s intentional?
: So you’re a sociopath on purpose?
: I’m just saying — the more you understand something, the harder it becomes to write.
: You stop thinking outside of the lines and pigeonhole yourself into adhering to a set of predetermined standards and expectations.
: I’m likely just preaching to the choir, though. Seeing as you’re a writer yourself, of course.
: Calling me a “writer” is generous when I’m average at best.
: Van Gogh was an average artist until he lopped off an ear and shot himself in the chest.
: I’m not even sure I could shoot myself in the chest properly given the size of my breasts.
: I suppose an ear will do then. Though, I can’t help but fear what Akira would do with such a thing. So I’ll gladly volunteer to be the recipient instead, should you be so inclined.
: I feel like this conversation is somehow making our relationship even more awkward.
: That seems highly plausible. I imagine this is a poor time to tell you I miss you, then?
: I’ve been feeling somewhat reflective lately. Nostalgic, even.
: And though the vast majority of my early memories are that of dark rooms granted temporary life in the form of a faded book-light, there’s one other constant that always comes to mind.
: And it’s one I neglected to properly care for. For that, I can’t help but be sorry.
: I understand that I am not easy to understand. And that most have come to know me as a self-motivated “x-factor” of sorts. I imagine they’re correct to a certain extent as well.
: I do value myself higher than others. But I believe that is the way everyone should be as human progress is inhibited and suppressed by selflessness at the expense of individuality.
: Distractions like this, like you, can be dangerous when it comes to time-sensitive and potentially life-altering action or information. So the logical decision is to cast such things aside.
: Nodoka...I don’t want to just be “logic” to you anymore. I’m a human being, not a factor in some equation you concocted about the most efficient way to exist.
: Again, it appears I’m failing to properly convey my feelings. So perhaps the struggle lies within me not understanding myself. At least not fully.
: But there’s something I do understand, Futaba. And it’s that I don’t enjoy existing much at all when I’m not doing it with you.

: So efficiency be damned if that is the root cause of this feeling. And damn the girl called Nodoka Nagasawa as well for thinking she could do justice to the one who sneaks in with the faded book-light.
: Despite the pedestal you place me on, I, too, struggle when it comes to pen and paper. And so that is the reason I believe you to be just as much of a writer as anyone else.
: I think that’s actually the sweetest thing you’ve ever said to me.
: Yes, well...ethylene glycol is sweet as well. It doesn’t mean you should ingest it.
: I will likely continue to make things hard for you. And upset you in ways that feel both disappointing and spontaneous.
: So much so that the logical decision for you would be to cut me off entirely. Yet my expected selfishness compels me to drag you down and ask that you reconsider such a thing.
: I never wanted to cut you off, Nodoka. I don’t enjoy existing as much without you either...
: You’ve always been an inspiration to me. And I find it harder to just...well, do anything when you’re not around for me to look up to.
: But so many things you do just make me sad. Or angry. And knowing you’re not going to change them makes it hard to just...indefinitely tolerate it.
: Like...putting the most personal moments of my life into a book? For the whole world to see?
: All I wanted was for others to feel the same way about you that I do. And that seeing the way the world perceives you would help reshape the ways in which you perceive yourself.
: The way I perceive myself isn’t something that anyone else’s thoughts are going to change.
: It is a burden I must bear and something that only I can counter.
: But you are failing...aren’t you?
: What happens if you do?
: There will be no room for a sequel, will there?
: Probably not...no.
: How frustrating it is that there are so many problems in this world that can’t be solved even when one knows how to solve them.
: Just one more case where it’s better to know nothing at all than everything at once.
: Knowing nothing sounds nice.
: I miss being a kid sometimes. I miss my biggest problems being the littlest things out there.
: I mean, technically speaking-
: You know what I mean.
: I know everything. That’s kind of my shtick. And also the thorn in my side.
: But I think I’m getting closer lately. To finally pulling it out. And finding the answers to the questions I’ve been asking all my life.
: Meaning...what exactly?
: Meaning I might finally be worth something to her.
: And that I can avoid the same fate.
